summary: Phase 8.3 Rider portal re-validation. Backend pytest: 17/17 PASS (extended RBAC: rider JWT 403 on /api/admin/drivers, /api/admin/orders, /api/admin/stores). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport) end-to-end PASS: rider login -> /rider/dashboard, dashboard greeting/online toggle/stats/active orders/recent earnings/quick links render, online switch toggles UI+backend (True->False, 'You are Online'->'You are Offline'), /rider/orders shows tabs Active/Delivered/All and pre-assigned order #32F7E8 appears under Delivered/All (order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8 was already delivered in iteration_12), /rider/earnings shows hero ₹25 + 1 deliveries + Last 14 days bar, /rider/profile shows Test Rider, rider@dwaarit.com, APPROVED, phone 9999999999, vehicle bike MH-12-AB-1234, Sign out -> /login. RBAC frontend: demo customer redirected from /rider/dashboard to /home. No red screens, no JS errors. Two non-blocking RN web warnings present (props.pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver web fallback).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns repeatedly: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking. Reference: shared UI components (e.g. Toast/Pressable wrappers) — search `pointerEvents=` across /app/frontend/src/components/.
Console warns 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation' — expected on Expo web preview, will not impact native builds.

action_items: (Optional) Note for main agent: review_request mentioned 'POST /api/rider/status' with body {status: 'online'} and order status 'picked_up'. Actual implementation uses POST /api/rider/online with {online: bool} and order statuses out_for_delivery/delivered. Frontend uses the actual contract, so functionally fine — but agent_to_agent spec wording does not match code. Recommend aligning spec wording in PRD.
(Optional) Migrate any remaining `pointerEvents` props to `style.pointerEvents` to silence Expo SDK deprecation warnings.

(Nice-to-have) After a rider marks an order delivered, /rider/orders 'Active' tab becomes empty; consider auto-switching to 'Delivered' tab or showing a hint banner with the latest delivered order id.
critical_code_review_comments: drivers.py POST /rider/orders/{order_id}/status uses `body: dict` — works (validates allowed values) but a Pydantic model would give stronger typing/422 semantics.

Dashboard 'useToken' hook reads from secure storage on mount only — OK because AuthContext stores token before navigation, but if token rotates while dashboard is mounted, API calls would still use the stale token. Low-priority.
RBAC enforcement is correct: /api/admin/* endpoints reject rider token with 401/403 (verified via 3 new pytest assertions).
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded rider drv_2a5c03fa24 and the existing assigned order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8 (already in 'delivered' state from iteration_12; status-flow test is idempotent and re-asserts 200 on delivered->delivered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8.3 fully green for the second iteration. Order ord_c5ecdd32f7e8 remains 'delivered' and rider earnings show ₹25 / 1 delivery. To re-test the full out_for_delivery -> delivered transition end-to-end via UI, seed a new order assigned to drv_2a5c03fa24 (e.g. via POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/assign with a fresh pending order).
